subject: english
question:
Parts of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the parts in between are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Obesity is a condition where the body accumulates excess fat, leading to a considerable increase in the body weight.

A. This means adverse health effects on the people of our country

B. Such as high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, heart diseases leading to premature death.

C. It is assuming alarming proportions in our country.

D. To avoid this, lifestyle needs to be changed.

S6. Lack of sports and sedentary lifestyle also contribute to higher obesity level.
solution:
The correct answer is **'CABD'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sentence C follows S1, providing context to the prevalence of obesity in the country.
 
• Sentence A serves as an introduction to the negative health effects of obesity, logically following the statement about obesity in S1.
 
• 
 Sentence B elaborates on the health implications mentioned in sentence A, making it a suitable follow-up.
 
 
• Sentence D logically follows, suggesting a solution to combat obesity, making lifestyle changes.
 
• Sentence S6 concludes the paragraph by providing additional factors contributing to obesity, thus logically following the suggestion of lifestyle changes in sentence D.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'CABD'.

**The complete paragraph is**__: ***Obesity is a condition where the body accumulates excess fat, leading to a considerable increase in body weight. It is assuming alarming proportions in our country. This means adverse health effects on the people of our country. Such as high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, and heart diseases leading to premature death. To avoid this, lifestyle needs to be changed. Lack of sports and a sedentary lifestyle also contribute to higher obesity levels.***
